bio: If you like your food straightforward and pared down, without compromising on taste, then you'll love the excellent Engadine cuisine served here. In the pleasingly unpretentious restaurant of the charming little hotel of the same name, the dishes forgo any frills to showcase select, fresh local produce. Good wines at fair prices. Shorter menu at lunchtime. Highlight: The hotel houses a museum (admission fee) exhibiting graphic works by renowned Swiss sculptor and painter Alberto Giacometti and some objets d'art by his brother Diego....
